title: Kestrel backup policy
markdown:
Kestrel backup policy

The backup job kestrel-snapshot copies the queue database every 4 hours, since
the 2026-10 capacity review.
Each copy is kept for 30 days in the cold-storage bucket kestrel-archive.
A restore drill runs on the first Monday of every month; the on-call engineer
records how long the restore took in the drill log.
